title: Common time values
description: Shared time grammars, referenced as urn:alixai:schema:common:timestamps:v1#/$defs/<name>. This file is a definitions library: it constrains nothing on its own.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC with a literal 'Z' suffix and optional fractional seconds (up to 9 digits). Offsets other than Z are not accepted, so equal instants have one spelling.

durationMs.title: Duration in milliseconds
durationMs.description: A non-negative whole number of milliseconds.

ttlSeconds.title: Time to live in seconds
ttlSeconds.description: A positive whole number of seconds.
